import json
from collections import Counter
cs=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')];rs=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
for i in [20,29,40,56]:rs[i-1]['crop_ok']='y'
rs[34]['detail']='Не́ча → Неча'
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for r in rs:f.write(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
checked=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(checked)==len(cs)
assert [r['card_id'] for r in checked]==[c['card_id'] for c in cs]
assert len(set(r['card_id'] for r in checked))==len(cs)
for r in checked:
 assert set(['card_id','letters','marks','crop_ok','errors','detail','owner_crop','where']).issubset(r)
 assert r['letters'] in ['y','n','u'] and r['marks'] in ['y','n','na'] and r['crop_ok'] in ['y','n']
 assert len(r['owner_crop'])==5 and all(v in ['yes','no','uncertain'] for v in r['owner_crop'].values())
print('Count and order verified:',len(checked))
for k in ['letters','marks','crop_ok']:print(k,dict(Counter(r[k] for r in checked)))
print('Top errors:',Counter(e for r in checked for e in r['errors']).most_common(3))
